title: Core: Layer CRUD operations (add, delete, reorder, rename)
description: Unit tests for layer management operations beyond what already exists. Test: addLayer at specific index (not just end), deleteLayer that is a folder (with children), reorderLayer across folder boundaries, renameLayer idempotent update. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/layer-advanced-crud.test.ts. Use functions from packages/core/src/engine/layers.ts.
